intro: Part 3: priorities under pressure. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In proposals for public services, distinguish the aim, the measure, the target group and the funding. A budget figure describes an estimated cost; it does not by itself decide whether the measure is effective.
